info.name: OMS Backend API
info.description: Nginx load-balancer and Gateway collection for OMS microservices. Every request runs. Run folder 01 to verify both Gateway replicas receive Nginx traffic, then register/login and run protected endpoints. Register user creates isolated user email for each run. Login requests store userToken or adminToken automatically.

request.description: Publishes draft event. Event service queues trusted `event.published` notification after successful database update.

Public proof for report: finds notification produced after draft-to-published event mutation. Collection Runner retries up to five times while Redis consumer processes event. Internal ingestion endpoint remains service-to-service only.

exec: const notification = pm.response.json().find((item) => item.data && item.data.event_id === pm.environment.get('eventId'));
else { pm.test('Published event notification exists', function () { pm.expect(notification, 'Redis consumer did not create event.published notification after five attempts.').to.exist; }); }

item.name: Get event by ID (user sees published only)

exec: const attendance = pm.response.json().find((item) => item.attendanceDate && item.attendanceDate.slice(0, 10) === today);

request.description: Admin correction emits `attendance.corrected` after successful database update.
Public proof for report: finds notification produced by admin attendance correction. Collection Runner retries up to five times while Redis consumer processes event.

exec: const notification = pm.response.json().find((item) => item.data && item.data.attendance_id === pm.environment.get('attendanceId'));

else { pm.test('Attendance correction notification exists', function () { pm.expect(notification, 'Redis consumer did not create attendance.corrected notification after five attempts.').to.exist; }); }

item.description: Run after user and admin login. Creates booking history plus one disposable room and book, then deletes only records safe to delete.

exec: const start = new Date(Date.now() + 72 * 60 * 60 * 1000); start.setUTCMinutes(0, 0, 0); pm.environment.set('bookingStart', start.toISOString()); pm.environment.set('bookingEnd', new Date(start.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString());
